tool_schemas.name: set_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Stores the provided Figma personal access token for this integration and uses it to authenticate subsequent requests to the Figma REST API. Returns a confirmation that the token was accepted and persisted for the current integration state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if api_key is missing or empty, UNAUTHORIZED if the token is rejected by Figma, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the upstream rate limit is hit while validating the token.

api_key.description: Your Figma API personal access token

tool_schemas.name: check_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Reports whether an API token is currently configured for this integration and ready to authorize Figma requests. Returns a boolean (and may include basic token status metadata when available). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if a configured token exists but is no longer accepted by Figma, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if checking requires an upstream call that is rate-limited.

tool_schemas.name: get_file
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a Figma file by file key (optionally at a specific version), returning the file document/metadata and updating the local cache and freshness markers for that file. If depth is provided, it limits the returned node expansion to the supported range; if branch_data is true, branch metadata is included when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid fileKey or out-of-range depth, UNAUTHORIZED if the token lacks access to the file, NOT_FOUND if the file key (or requested version) does not exist or is not accessible, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the upstream rate limit is exceeded.

fileKey.description: The key of the file to get

version.description: Optional. A specific version ID to get

depth.description: Optional. Depth of nodes to return (1-4)

branch_data.description: Optional. Include branch data if true

tool_schemas.name: get_file_nodes
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves only the specified node IDs from a given Figma file, returning a nodes map keyed by node id and updating cached metadata for the fetched nodes. Supports optional depth (within the supported range) and an optional version to read from. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fileKey or node_ids are missing/empty or depth is out of range, UNAUTHORIZED if the token lacks access to the file, NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist/is not accessible (or if the requested version does not exist), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the upstream rate limit is exceeded.

fileKey.description: The key of the file to get nodes from

node_ids.description: Array of node IDs to get

depth.description: Optional. Depth of nodes to return (1-4)

version.description: Optional. A specific version ID to get

tool_schemas.name: get_image
tool_schemas.description: Requests rendered image URLs for the given node IDs in a Figma file, returning a mapping from node id to image URL for the chosen format and options. Validates scale and rendering options and records any relevant pagination/caching cursors used by the upstream image pipeline when applicable. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/empty ids, invalid format, or scale outside the supported range, UNAUTHORIZED if the token lacks access to the file, NOT_FOUND if the file is not accessible, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the upstream rate limit is exceeded.

fileKey.description: The key of the file to get images from

ids.description: Array of node IDs to render

scale.description: Optional. Scale factor to render at (0.01-4)

svg_include_id.description: Optional. Include IDs in SVG output

svg_simplify_stroke.description: Optional. Simplify strokes in SVG output

tool_schemas.name: get_image_fills
tool_schemas.description: Lists the image fill assets referenced by a Figma file and returns URLs for those images, refreshing the local cached asset metadata for the file. This endpoint does not page results; it returns the full set provided by Figma for the file. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid fileKey, UNAUTHORIZED if the token lacks access to the file, NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist or is not accessible, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the upstream rate limit is exceeded.

fileKey.description: The key of the file to get image fills from

tool_schemas.name: get_comments
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves comments for a Figma file and returns the list of comments as provided by Figma, while updating the integration’s local comment cache (including any previously soft-deleted records). This endpoint returns the complete set returned by Figma for the file (no cursor pagination parameters are supported here). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid fileKey, UNAUTHORIZED if the token lacks access to the file, NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist or is not accessible, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the upstream rate limit is exceeded.

fileKey.description: The key of the file to get comments from

tool_schemas.name: post_comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new comment on the specified Figma file (or posts a reply when comment_id is provided) and returns the created comment record, also persisting it in the local comment cache. If client_meta is provided, it is validated as a position anchor (coordinates and optional node reference) for the comment. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if message is missing/empty or client_meta is malformed, UNAUTHORIZED if the token lacks permission to comment on the file, NOT_FOUND if the file is not accessible (or if replying to a comment_id that does not exist/is not accessible), CONFLICT if attempting to reply to a comment thread/state that cannot accept replies, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the upstream rate limit is exceeded.

fileKey.description: The key of the file to comment on

comment_id.description: Optional. ID of comment to reply to

tool_schemas.name: delete_comment
tool_schemas.description: Soft-deletes a comment for the given file by comment id and returns a confirmation of deletion, recording the deletion in the local comment cache. If the comment is already deleted, the operation is idempotent and returns success without creating a second deletion record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid identifiers, UNAUTHORIZED if the token lacks permission to delete the comment, NOT_FOUND if the file or comment does not exist/is not accessible, CONFLICT if the comment cannot be deleted due to upstream state restrictions, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the upstream rate limit is exceeded.

fileKey.description: The key of the file to delete a comment from

comment_id.description: ID of the comment to delete

tool_schemas.name: get_team_projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects for a team and returns a single page of projects along with the next cursor when more results are available; page_size controls the number of items per page and cursor continues a prior listing. Results are cached with the returned pagination cursor to support incremental refreshes. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid team_id or page_size, UNAUTHORIZED if the token lacks access to the team, NOT_FOUND if the team does not exist or is not accessible, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the upstream rate limit is exceeded.

page_size.description: Optional. Number of items per page

tool_schemas.name: get_project_files
tool_schemas.description: Returns the files for the given Figma project ID, optionally including branch metadata when `branch_data` is true; results are paged with `page_size` and a `cursor` you pass back to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project_id` is missing/empty, if `page_size` is not a positive number, or if `cursor` is provided but invalid for this project; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid integration token is configured and FORBIDDEN if the token cannot access the project. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or is not visible to the token, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream Figma quotas are exceeded.

page_size.description: Optional. Number of items per page

branch_data.description: Optional. Include branch data if true

tool_schemas.name: get_team_components
tool_schemas.description: Returns the team-scoped component catalog for the given team ID from the integration cache/backing Figma API; results are paged using `page_size` and `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `team_id` is missing/empty, if `page_size` is not a positive number, or if `cursor` is invalid for this listing; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid token is configured and FORBIDDEN if the token lacks access to the team. Raises NOT_FOUND if the team does not exist or is not visible to the token, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream Figma quotas are exceeded.

page_size.description: Optional. Number of items per page

tool_schemas.name: get_file_components
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of components defined in the specified file key (file-scoped components) as available through the integration’s cached metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `fileKey` is missing/empty; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid token is configured and FORBIDDEN if the token cannot access the file. Raises NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist or is not visible to the token, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream Figma quotas are exceeded.

fileKey.description: The key of the file to get components from

tool_schemas.name: get_component
tool_schemas.description: Returns the component metadata for a single component identified by its `key`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `key` is missing/empty; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid token is configured and FORBIDDEN if the token cannot access the component’s owning resources. Raises NOT_FOUND if the component key does not exist or is not visible to the token, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream Figma quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_team_component_sets
tool_schemas.description: Returns the team-scoped component set catalog for the given team ID; results are paged with `page_size` and `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `team_id` is missing/empty, if `page_size` is not a positive number, or if `cursor` is invalid for this listing; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid token is configured and FORBIDDEN if the token lacks access to the team. Raises NOT_FOUND if the team does not exist or is not visible to the token, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream Figma quotas are exceeded.

page_size.description: Optional. Number of items per page

tool_schemas.name: get_team_styles
tool_schemas.description: Returns the team-scoped styles catalog for the given team ID; results are paged with `page_size` and `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `team_id` is missing/empty, if `page_size` is not a positive number, or if `cursor` is invalid for this listing; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid token is configured and FORBIDDEN if the token lacks access to the team. Raises NOT_FOUND if the team does not exist or is not visible to the token, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream Figma quotas are exceeded.

page_size.description: Optional. Number of items per page

tool_schemas.name: get_file_styles
tool_schemas.description: Returns the list of styles defined in the specified file key (file-scoped styles) as available through the integration’s cached metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `fileKey` is missing/empty; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid token is configured and FORBIDDEN if the token cannot access the file. Raises NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist or is not visible to the token, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream Figma quotas are exceeded.

fileKey.description: The key of the file to get styles from

tool_schemas.name: get_style
tool_schemas.description: Returns the style metadata for a single style identified by its `key`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `key` is missing/empty; raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid token is configured and FORBIDDEN if the token cannot access the style’s owning resources. Raises NOT_FOUND if the style key does not exist or is not visible to the token, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream Figma quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity for the currently configured Figma integration token, including user/handle metadata when available, the integration-scoped permissions (scopes) the backend can infer, and current upstream quota/rate-limit consumption if known. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no active token is configured or the token is rejected by Figma, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the upstream identity check is rate-limited.

include_quota.description: Optional. If true, include the most recent known upstream rate-limit/quota counters when available.

tool_schemas.name: list_entities
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached Figma entities (teams, projects, files, etc.) from the local integration store with filtering and cursor pagination. Returns entities in most-recently-updated order unless a stable sort is provided. Refuses invalid filters and refuses access if no active token is configured for this integration.

parent_entity_id.description: Optional. Filter by parent entity id (e.g., projects under a team, files under a project).

figma_id.description: Optional. Filter by upstream Figma id.

file_key.description: Optional. Filter entities associated to a file key (primarily for file entities).

branch_data_included.description: Optional. If set, filter by whether branch data has been included for this entity during listing fetches.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of rows to return (1-1000). Default is 100.

cursor.description: Optional. Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list_entities response.

tool_schemas.name: get_entity
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single cached Figma entity by its local id. Returns the stored entity record including last fetch time and raw payload when present. Raises NOT_FOUND if the entity does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if no active token is configured for this integration.

id.description: The local id of the entity to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: update_entity
tool_schemas.description: Updates a cached Figma entity record in the local integration store. Supports lifecycle transitions via status where allowed (active↔archived, active/archived→deleted). Returns the updated entity. Refuses invalid transitions, refuses updates to deleted entities, and refuses access if no active token is configured for this integration.

id.description: The local id of the entity to update.

name.description: Optional. Human-readable name to store for this entity.

status.description: Optional. Set the lifecycle status. Must be a valid transition for the current status.

branch_data_included.description: Optional. Marks whether branch data has been included for this entity during vendor listing fetches.

list_cursor.description: Optional. Opaque vendor pagination cursor to persist on this entity (typically teams/projects for list paging).

list_page_size.description: Optional. Persisted vendor page size used for listing fetches (1-1000).

tool_schemas.name: list_comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists locally cached comments for a given file key with optional inclusion of soft-deleted rows, returning results in descending created_at order. Does not call Figma; this is for inspecting the integration’s stored comment state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid fileKey, and UNAUTHORIZED if no active token is configured for this integration.

fileKey.description: The key of the file whose cached comments should be listed.

include_deleted.description: Optional. If true, include comments with status='deleted'. Default false.

limit.description: Optional. Maximum number of comments to return (1-1000). Default is 100.

cursor.description: Optional. Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list_comments response.

tool_schemas.name: revalidate_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Forces a re-validation of the currently active stored Figma token against Figma and updates the account lifecycle status accordingly. Returns the account record with updated status/last_validated_at and any validation_error. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no token is configured or the token is rejected, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the upstream validation call is rate-limited.

force.description: Optional. If true, bypass any cached validation result and always call Figma.

metadata.name: Figma API Integration
metadata.description: This backend stores a local integration state for accessing the Figma REST API: an encrypted personal access token, cached metadata for teams/projects/files, and cached design system assets (components, component sets, styles). It also stores file-scoped comments created/queried through the integrat
